   A record roll call was requested.

   Senator Bousselot took the chair at 4:39 p.m.

   President Sinclair took the chair at 5:00 p.m.
85th Day                     MONDAY, APRIL 7, 2025                    705



  Senator Rozenboom moved that the bill be read the last time now
and placed upon its passage, which motion prevailed by a voice vote,
and the bill was read the last time.

   On the question “Shall the bill pass?” (H.F. 954), the vote was:
Yeas, 32:

Weiner           Winckler            Zimmer

Absent, 3:

Celsi            De Witt             Wahls

  The bill, having received a constitutional majority, was declared to
have passed the Senate and the title was agreed to.

                    CONSIDERATION OF BILL
                   (Unfinished Business Calendar)

   Senator Whitver asked and received unanimous consent to take up
for consideration Senate File 304.

Senate File 304

   On motion of Senator Salmon, Senate File 304, a bill for an act
providing an exception to a minor’s legal capacity to consent to the
provision of medical care or services for a sexually transmitted disease
or infection, placed on the Unfinished Business Calendar on April 3,
2025, was taken up for consideration.
706                        JOURNAL OF THE SENATE                 85th Day



   Senator Salmon moved that the bill be read the last time now and
placed upon its passage, which motion prevailed by a voice vote, and
the bill was read the last time.
